Hook: April Fools dessert: soft serve that is 100 percent banana. One ingredient, 5 minutes
Line 1: Peel 4 ripe bananas, the spottier the sweeter, slice into coins and freeze on a plate for at least 3 hours
Line 2: Blend the frozen coins in a food processor or strong blender. It looks crumbly for a minute, keep going and scrape the sides
Line 3: At about 3 minutes it turns creamy like soft serve. Add 1 to 2 tablespoons of milk only if the blades stall
Line 4: Eat it soft, or freeze 1 hour for scoops. Stir in a tablespoon of peanut butter, cocoa or a handful of berries if you like

The only April Fools trick worth playing on your family: serve this and tell them afterward that it is a banana. Peel four ripe bananas, the spottier the sweeter, slice them into coins and freeze on a plate for at least three hours. Blend the frozen coins in a food processor or a strong blender. Hook: 4 questions at the pharmacy counter that can shrink your prescription bill

Line 3: Do you have a discount card or manufacturer coupon you can run? Pharmacists can check in seconds, but only if you ask
Line 4: Is there a similar medication on my plan's preferred list? Ask them to flag it to your prescriber. Never switch or stop on your own
Punchline: Pharmacists answer these every single day, and most people never ask. Five minutes at the counter can save real money every month.
